versions.note: 15 mm birch shell; front set back 35 mm, no grille; box 85 cm deep to keep the air and tuning; back on cleats, removable on the prototype; driver screwed, not bolted; ring braces at 25 and 49 cm for the handles; build tips from BFM's Celestion plan; bracing notes: grain direction, a gap at the spine ends, sealed handle cups, and knock and sweep tests on the prototype; the spines slide through slots in the ring braces
tooth tips stay square; 3D-printed wedges behind the teeth instead of wooden fillers
checked against the TSQ1845 drawing: 415 mm cut-out, M6 tee nuts; rings moved to 22 and 48 cm for the handles; mouth detail; mirrored pairs

summary: 61 x 61 cm face, 85 cm deep: the Titans' grid
15 mm birch shell; 15 mm front set back 35 mm, with no grille; 12 mm back on cleats
Celestion TSQ1845 (8 ohm), tuned about 25 Hz
two triangular ducts behind stepped mouths on one diagonal
about 49 kg with the driver: a two-person lift

tooth tips stay square: the Pirámide look. Give the hole's front edges a light 6 mm round-over (the wall ends too)

the duct behind: 191 cm2, a third more than the hole
a wedge from the side. 2 per mouth behind the teeth, 2 at the step ends (one mirrored)

notes.text: shaded: the top-left duct, beyond the cut

spines: 6 cm on edge under the top and over the bottom, slid in from the back through slots in the ring braces; they stop 5 mm short of the back brace (or felt the ends) so they can't rattle against it
ring braces at 25 and 49 cm: 8 cm frames that keep every wall span under 35 cm, with a 12 mm x 6 cm slot top and bottom for the spines
back brace cross: two 6 cm strips on edge, fixed to the back
doubler: the driver screws into 27 mm (pilot-drilled). On a prototype for trying other drivers, M6 bolts into tee nuts instead
glue blocks behind the front panel
cleats: 20 mm strips of 12 mm ply round the back opening, set in 12 mm. The back screws to them, with foam gasket tape on the prototype so it comes off
outline: handle cup in the far side, between the rings, centred on the weight (about 38 cm back)

notes.text: duct air: a right triangle, legs 19.6 cm
diagonal panel: 12 mm birch, both long edges bevelled 45 degrees, glued and screwed into the corner
ring frame, cut at 45 degrees where it meets each duct panel and glued to it
spines (cut), through their slots in the ring frame
beyond: back brace cross, the cleats round the back, and 5 cm wadding in the two quarters away from the duct ends
glue blocks along the two duct-free long edges
Handles: sealed cups in the side panels between the ring braces (see S-S); a cup up to 13 cm tall clears the duct panels by about 1.2 cm.
